decisions.reason: Although it fits the firm's web-GIS knowledge base well, its disappearance from the website after the 2018 launch suggests weak standalone traction, so management would likely redeploy the learning and code into core solutions rather than keep marketing it as a separate product.

A GIS solution platform is highly aligned with the firm's core enterprise geospatial capabilities and standards-based R&D, and its stronger presentation in 2019 indicates enough promise to justify continued development and commercialization.

Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's existing integration and mobile GIS competences, and its continued dedicated presence suggests the firm can absorb user feedback and improve it for public- and private-sector workflows.

The search extension builds directly on the firm's established web-map architecture, and the 2019 version update is a clear sign of ongoing learning and refinement that supports keeping it on the market.
